narrative.intro: McKesson has $11.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. McKesson won 2,090 federal awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $5.3M. McKesson obligations are down 6.8% year over year. McKesson obligations by fiscal year show a multi-year trend: FY21 $7.7B, FY22 $8.4B, FY23 $9.5B, FY24 $9B, FY25 $11.9B and FY26 $11.1B. McKesson sells largely into Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing, which accounts for $11.1B of obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Veterans Affairs is the dominant buyer, with $10.8B in obligations. Other federal buyers include the Department of Justice with $157M and the Department of Health and Human Services with $88.6M. Additional buyers include the Department of Homeland Security with $9.3M, the Peace Corps with $405K and the Department of State with $0. Other NAICS markets with recorded obligations in FY2026 to date include Drugs and Druggists' Sundries Merchant Wholesalers $6.9M, Major Household Appliance Manufacturing $37.5K, Medical Laboratories $15K, Medicinal and Botanical Manufacturing $14.6K and General Medical and Surgical Hospitals $259.

sections.heading: How has McKesson's federal contract activity changed over time?
sections.body: McKesson obligations by fiscal year are FY21 $7.7B, FY22 $8.4B, FY23 $9.5B, FY24 $9B, FY25 $11.9B and FY26 $11.1B. McKesson obligations are down 6.8% year over year in FY2026 to date. McKesson won 2,090 awards in FY2026 to date with an average award size of $5.3M. McKesson total obligations in FY2026 to date stand at $11.1B.

sections.heading: Who are McKesson's main federal customers and what do they buy?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $10.8B for McKesson in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice obligated $157M and the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $88.6M. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $9.3M and the Peace Corps obligated $405K, while the Department of State shows $0 in obligations. Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing is the top market with $11.1B in obligations in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: How much does McKesson make from federal contracts?
faq.a: McKesson has $11.1B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. McKesson won 2,090 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $5.3M and obligations down 6.8% year over year.

The Department of Veterans Affairs is the largest buyer, with $10.8B in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice obligated $157M and the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $88.6M, with additional obligations from the Department of Homeland Security ($9.3M), the Peace Corps ($405K) and the Department of State ($0).

faq.q: What does McKesson sell to the government?
faq.a: McKesson sells primarily pharmaceutical and related medical products, led by Pharmaceutical Preparation Manufacturing with $11.1B in obligations in FY2026 to date. Other listed markets include Drugs and Druggists' Sundries Merchant Wholesalers ($6.9M), Major Household Appliance Manufacturing ($37.5K), Medical Laboratories ($15K), Medicinal and Botanical Manufacturing ($14.6K) and General Medical and Surgical Hospitals ($259).
